An automorphism φ of the free group Fn on the free generators x1 , x2 , . . . , xn
is called conjugating if xφ      −1
                           i = ti xπ(i) ti , i = 1, 2, . . . , n, for some permutation π ∈ Sn
and some elements ti ∈ Fn . The set of conjugating automorphisms fixing the product
x1 x2 · · · xn forms the braid group Bn . The group Bn is linear for any n ⩾ 2, while
the group of all automorphisms Aut Fn is not linear for n ⩾ 3. Is the group of all
conjugating automorphisms linear for n ⩾ 3?                                    V. G. Bardakov
